correctness.rationale: The bounded-solution m recurrence has explicit ℓ¹ inverse G_j=(√3−2)^|j|/(2√3), and no nonzero bounded homogeneous solution. The step curvature is a difference of two translates of G; the unique central derivative is strictly positive, tail quadratic has exactly one zero inside (0,1), and its signed integral vanishes. The two geometric tails sum exactly to −2P(alpha), producing K=(2+√3+2√(2−√3))/3. Every real bi-infinite BV sequence has an absolutely convergent jump expansion. Translation-invariance and triangle inequality extend the bound to all sequences and the step attains equality. The standalone checker rederives exact polynomial identities and compares independently solved finite spline systems plus random input tests. No finite test substitutes for the proof.

value.rationale: Infinite cardinal cubic interpolation is nonlocal and widely used; precise worst-case TV growth controls edge amplification of C² reconstruction from sampled bounded-variation data. The exact radical and single-jump extremal resolve a natural unrestricted sharp invariant not determined by classical approximation order or local shape analysis. It provides a rigorous stability benchmark that discriminates interpolatory cubic splines from positive variation-diminishing quasi-interpolation, and from finite natural cubic interpolation. The nonlocal Green-decay plus absolute quadratic tail integration is substantive, not a naming change or arbitrary small enumeration.
